alt: Second page of L.A. Care's formal response to the Government Claim, advising the claimant to seek immediate legal counsel, signed electronically by Associate Counsel William Seldeen on July 13, 2026, and cc'ing Paralegal Felix Huerta.
summary: This document is Page 2 of L.A. Care Health Plan's official response to Nicolas Hernandez's Government Tort Claim, dated July 13, 2026. It contains the standard statutory warnings directing the claimant to consult an attorney immediately if they wish to file a court action. The document is electronically DocuSigned by William Seldeen, Associate Counsel of the Legal Services Department, with a copy routed to Felix Huerta, Paralegal III. Together with Page 1, this completes the official written denial, establishing proof of administrative exhaustion under the California Government Claims Act.
full_text:
Response to Government Claim, July 13, 2026, Page 2

You may seek the advice of an attorney of your choice in connection with this matter. If you desire to consult an attorney, you should do so immediately.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me at the mailing address above or by email at wseldeen@lacare.org.

Respectfully,

DocuSigned by:
William Seldeen
Associate Counsel
L.A. Care Health Plan

Cc: Felix Huerta, Paralegal III (email only)
